name: Mohammad Samadi
headline: Craftsman building things that last.
hero_bio: Decades of hands-on experience turning ideas into finished, dependable work. Careful, honest, and built to last — no shortcuts.
about:
I have spent my career doing work I am proud to put my name on. Every project gets the same attention to detail, whether it is big or small.

I believe in doing things right the first time, communicating clearly, and treating every client like a neighbour. That is how I have built lasting relationships and a reputation I stand behind.
contact_subtext: Have a project in mind or just want to talk it through? Reach out by phone or email and I'll get back to you.

experience.description: Delivering high-quality work for clients across the region, managing projects end to end from first call to final handover.
Led teams on large projects, mentored junior workers, and set the standard for quality and safety on every site.
